name: Starter Pack
summary:
Jump into Hyper Dash wielding the exclusive Golden Dragon skin for the pistol that will impress your opponents, along with 2400 in-game credits to spend on bling for the rest of your arsenal!

The Starter Pack Bundle includes:
- 2400 In-game Credits
- Exclusive Golden Dragon pistol skin.

*The exclusive items are only available through this bundle. They won't be purchasable in-game through credits.
